title: Host capacity asks: what the machine's own read claims from the one budget

Policy.description: The one budget of a machine is the host capacity gate. A read that waits for memory it needs, or runs an owner that needs the whole machine, publishes one ask file per process in the `asks` directory of the gate: the pool of the machine reads the asks together with the grants and the queue, so the read has the first claim and the pool gets what it leaves. An ask is alive while its process is and while it was rewritten within `missedBeats` of its own heartbeat.
